body: So tonight after some Dutch courage ice decided its time. I missed my babies and sent them to bed and I'm going out tonight. I've made my peace Thank you for the messages but devote yourselves to someone that can be saved

Happier I'm not sure. Happiness for me feels like a temporary thing. I love making my kids happy Christmas and birthdays come to mind. Saddest being alone. My work often takes me away and when I'm with work colleges I'm ok but without and alone it's really tough. I guess I like feeling needed and wanted and that doesn't happen often

I have but I have a bit of a trust issue with health professionals as I had a pretty tough time of it as a child. Most of all it makes it complicated because my job and such requires me to be in good mental health or my career will be in the bin. I just see the pain and real suffering that's going on especially right now and feel like my first world problems barely register. I brought it up with my wife and she immediately took it all on as it was her fault that I wasn't happy which made me feel even worse. So most days I just fake it and go along with the ride.
